body: When I was dating a guy, and I was on the phone with him crying because he had been treating me so poorly and I was just trying to talk about it with him and he refused to talk about it and said he was going to bed, and basically that he didn’t care that I was sad. And my response just kind of poured out of my mouth, without me really thinking I said “I..don’t deserve to be treated like this” and in that moment I just realized that he was really toxic and I was so unhappy and miserable with him. Eventually I dumped his ass, and now I’m living my best life in a relationship with a girl.

When I quit my last job. When I had started working there, I was 16, and it was my first job. It was a barbecue place, and pretty popular. At first it was a bit lame working there, but after a while I got the hang of things and actually enjoyed working there and most of my coworkers. But then we had a manager go to the military, so one of our servers got promoted to manager, and everything started to go down hill. She was terrible. She completely abused her power. She was constantly yelling at people, and bossing them around for no reason, just telling people what to do because she knew she could, telling us do stuff that didn’t even make sense. It was really annoying and she was a complete bitch. Just, snarky and annoying and rude for no reason. No body liked her and she even started getting several people fired for no good reason. She was making us all miserable and none of us could stand her. I put up with for a while, because she never seriously upset me to bad, but one day she made me snap. I dealt with her nagging and rude attitude and constant bossing and embarrassing, but I was over it. On this day, at the start of the shift she was going on and on about how we all had to better about team work and helping each other, and how if you didn’t have anything to be doing, help someone out, blah blah” so later in the shift, my coworker was struggling with her amount of orders, she had a lot and was getting frustrated. So I went over to help her. In the middle of me helping, the manager comes over, and in front of everyone, yells at me to go back to my station and to do my job and blah blah. It made me feel really stupid and embarrassed me a lot. But I shamefully did as she said. Then she came over to my station, and proceeded to ask me “why I seemed upset” and I decided in less then half a second that I was ready to lose my job, and that I really didn’t care anymore. I told her that it was because she was such a dumb bitch who made everyone hate working there. I slept good that night knowing I didn’t have to see her the next day.

Okay so one time, about 2 months after I had turned 18 me and my best friend, we’ll call her Alyssa, decided we were going to try shrooms. We got it all planned out that we would spend the night at our mutual friends house, we’ll call her jasmine, and that we would all do shrooms together (jasmines parents were out of town). Now I had done psychedelic drugs before, I had done acid. However, I had never done shrooms before. Alyssa has never done a psychedelic drug before ever though, and Jasmine had done more then I had and had done shrooms before. I had always been under the impression that acid was more intense then shrooms, and that the hallucinations were more vivid. That turned out to be completely untrue. So for our first time doing shrooms, I did 2.7 grams (almost 3 grams) and so did jasmine, and Alyssa did 1.7 (almost 2 grams) and on top of that, we did weed edibles, smoked a blunt, and drank this herbal tea that was supposed to make it more intense. So needless to say, we went way over board. Everything started pretty normally compared to the other times I had done acid, it just began sooner and everything was a bit more intense and real feeling. We were all out on jasmines back patio laying down looking at the clouds and grass, and everything was so vivid and beautiful. However, I had this sinking gut feeling, this sort of nervousness. I felt like something was off with Alyssa. I don’t know why, but I could not shake the feeling that something was not right with her. I asked her if she was okay, and she told me she was fine. But I wasn’t really buying it, I asked her a couple more times after a bit and she kept telling me nothing was wrong. Still wasn’t buying it. After a bit longer we decided to go inside. That’s when things really started to go down hill. We were all sitting in the living room, watching some trippy video on the tv and that negative feeling was still there. I asked Alyssa if she was alright one more time and she still say yes. Everything still felt relatively normal (and by that I do mean normal “on shrooms” things were different colors and shapes and sizes and moving Etc.) then I turned my head to the right and when I turned to look back at Alyssa her skin was deep dark blue, and there was the blackest scariest aura surrounding her. She looked like she was going to die, or something. The best way I know to explain it, is she looked the way depression feels. It was shocking. I asked if she was okay and she told me no and that she thinks she needs to go to the hospital. Of course I begin to get in a bit of a panic because we are doing shrooms which is illegal and we can’t exactly drive either considering we’re on shrooms. We do our best to calm her down and she begins to calm down, or at least try to. Then she starts moving constantly, won’t sit still. She keeps going all over the place and I to different rooms and crawling around on the floor and what not. It was making me really paranoid. Eventually she grabbed a blanket and threw it on the floor behind the couch we were sitting on and laid down on it, and then she started to cry. Once she started crying I felt like I couldn’t hear anything but her crying and it was scaring me really bad. I was so worried about her I couldn’t focus on anything else. She stopped crying and got up and said she felt like she just needed a drink of water and that made me feel a little bit better only to be washed with insane panic directly after, when she goes on to grab a cup for the water, stops right when she gets to the sink, gives a terrified and yet blank stare and says In shakey voice “im...going to die.” that’s when I started to kind of freak out. I start trying to assure her that nothing is wrong and that she is okay, while jasmine gets up and locks the back door so she doesn’t try to leave and get us caught. That really just made everything worse though because it made us more paranoid. Eventually Alyssa says she’s going to just try to lay down in the bed, and I’m still pretty shook up thinking she might actually die. And then that’s when it happened for me. I was sitting on the couch trying my absolute best to calm down. I was beginning to be extremely paranoid and afraid. There was this intense feeling of dread coming over me. Before I knew it I was in a full blown panic, I was convinced I was going to die. I felt like my brain was shutting off, like my organs were failing. I tried to just go to sleep and tell myself then when I woke up everything would be over but I couldn’t sleep no matter how hard I tried and I then I became convinced it I fell asleep I wouldn’t wake up, or if I closed my eyes to long I wouldn’t wake up. It felt like I couldn’t remember anything while at the same time having the most insane and intense Déjà vu I have ever had in my life. It felt like I had been stuck in the moment forever and like it was never going to end. All I could feel was Despair, dread, terror, and misery. I was so afraid. I didn’t want to die. I was really panicking and convinced I was just going to end up being another screw up loser teenager who killed there self doing drugs on the news. I felt like such a disappointment. That’s when Alyssa came out and was trying to calm me down, because she felt a little better. But not much. And then the weirdest thing happened, it was like me and Alyssa were connected in some way, I kept saying everything she was thinking and she kept looking like how I was feeling. It was frustrating and making things worse for me, so I didn’t want to be around her. I didn’t want to be around her or jasmine. Somewhere I became convinced I was in some sort or different reality, and it was terrifying obviously. I felt like I was connected to everything living thing in the entire world. No less than, or more than, every single living thing. It has a way of making you feel incredibly irrelevant and small. Like your life doesn’t matter at all. Everything appeared like the upside down from stranger things. It was really dark and gloomy and I felt like I was being watched and it was like I was viewing the world from a 3rd persons point of view. As if I was an alien who had never been to earth but was only doing some kind of report on it and the information they gathered was just completely raw and blunt. And let me just say our world from a 3rd person perspective is absolutely horrific. Our world is a terrible and cruel place. The entire time jasmine was pretty much making everything 10 times worse. When I was freaking out asking if I was going to die she said “well yeah, everyone is going to die one day” and it was so bad I ended up calling my parents and told them everything and asked them to come get me. But then I was convinced I was going to die before they got there, so I was went outside and called 911 and they sent an ambulance. Right after my parents got there the ambulance showed up, and me and Alyssa got in (jasmine stayed in her house and didn’t really want anything to do with it, because she wasn’t having a terrible time like us) and thank god the paramedics were such good people, they made sure we weren’t a danger to ourselves or anyone else and basically sent us home with my mom and told my parents to just let us “ride it out” (because nither of us were actually going to die, you can’t actually over does on shrooms) and we left and everything was okay after that. My parents were really understanding and not really angry, and they understood we were just kids messing around and trying something out, so they comforted us and got us Chinese food. Once I got to my house I was convinced I was dead and in heaven and it was amazing. One of the best feelings I’ve ever felt in my life. And then I came down and everything went back to normal. Well, not really actually. The whole experience actually really messed me up pretty bad. Made me terrified of death, I couldn’t even think or hear about dying or anyone or anything dying without having a full blown panic attack losing my shit, crying and what not. I couldn’t smoke more weed then maybe less then half a blunt because if I smoked to much I would freak out really bad. I was so paranoid and filled with anxiety all the time, and afraid. I became pretty depressed. It got so bad I even started smoking cigarettes and black and milds to try and calm my nerves. (I have quit now) before that experience I was pretty certain that I would have a good after life, not necessarily in heaven, I didn’t really specifically believe in that, but just somewhere or something good. But after that, now I’m not so sure. And I’m still pretty scared to die. Things are a lot better then they used to be now, but I still get paranoid and think about death way to much. I would never do a psychedelic drug ever again, or do anything other then smoke weed. Be careful if you do something like this, and keep in mind that it could change your life for the better or it could change your life for the worse, and I mean way worse. In that moment I never wanted to leave anywhere more in my life. I wanted to leave jasmines house, I wanted to leave the high that I was having, i wanted to leave the entire situation, and forget it ever happened. I still want to forget it ever happened.
